events.title: Warren Buffett’s Berkshire Hathaway Dumped 16 Stocks in Q1, But the Chevron Sale Was the Largest
events.body: Berkshire exited 16 stocks in Q1 under CEO Greg Abel, but its Chevron stock sale stood apart. Despite trimming its stake, Berkshire still appears deeply committed to the energy giant.
